summary: AGNT, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 3, 2026 disclosing a stock purchase agreement with Frank Selden as trustee of the Gratitude 2022 Trust to buy back 8,693,290 common shares at $3.68 each, a 10% discount to the five-day VWAP. The trust's sole beneficiaries are adult family members of Chairman/CEO Glenn Sanford. The audit committee of independent directors approved under the related-person policy, calling the price fair. Closing is conditioned on customary terms and a medallion-guaranteed transfer power, with automatic termination absent closing by September 11, 2026, subject to limited unilateral extension. Watch related-party governance and closing execution risk.
